item.title: Rallying Cry – November 11, 2026
item.description: Scott Colom makes history as Mississippi’s first openly LGBTQ+ state senator, while rescued baobabs embark on a 900km journey to safety, and Kenya celebrates progress toward ending its Ebola outbreak.
